scope: Independent source review and pure synthetic tests only; actual declaration, preparation, cached row or mask decoding, labels, fitting, primary metrics and actual rerank are not executed.

findings.detail: Frozen R30 rerank_cached_row code receives a private F31 rank alias via FunctionType and SimpleNamespace; source pins fail closed. No parent global, function, raw archive, coefficient, source q, state, covariance, guide or index rewriting. Selection changes only by the explicitly new admission and declared top-level metadata corrections.

Public CAL/REST rerank restricts workers to integers1..3. Pending submissions are at most workers; rows are decoded, reranked, spooled and released within workers. Parent retains small index and summary entries. Output spools are exclusive new files; failure cancels pending work, terminates workers and preserves failed/completed/pending IDs.

Every operational stage requires caller-provided exact64-lowercase-hex central SHA, checks file hash before JSON decode, verifies profile/raw generation/238 population, and verifies all central source/input/protected maps. No default or alternate declaration substitution.

Original full29 operational closure plus central and operator maps are merged with conflicts rejected. Every parent spool SHA is verified before preparation. Runtime loads and stage completion revalidate source/input/protected/parent immutable maps. Source snapshots are SHA checked.

Original ordered unique inventory238 and CAL46/TEST49/REMAINDER143 entries are required. CAL seal binds PREP, execution, summary, index and journal. Each of46 spools is directly compared to its original CAL index SHA before seven CAL files plus46 spool files are frozen; these53 hashes are verified during REST loading, emit and finalization.

Original CAL46 and REST192 indices determine order irrespective of completion order. All zero-selection rows are retained. Finalization verifies both partition seals and copies exact compressed CAL then REST bytes into a two-member gzip without JSON reencoding or recompression. C.rows reads all238 and every canonical digest/order/unique ID/partition plus selection counts are checked.

One json.dumps(C.finite(row),ensure_ascii=False,separators=(comma,colon),allow_nan=False)+newline text write per row; gzip1 affects compression bytes only. Synthetic NaN/Inf/array/negative-zero/Unicode data decompresses byte-identically to original C.save_rows. Existing files cannot be overwritten.
